name: nefesh
title: Nefesh — Real-Time Human State Awareness for AI
description: B2B middleware API that fuses biometric signals (heart rate, HRV, voice, facial expression, text sentiment) into a unified stress score (0-100) with behavioral adaptation prompts. One endpoint, any sensor, any device. MCP native.

authentication.instructions: Option A: Connect without a key and use the request_api_key tool to get one automatically. Option B: Sign up at https://nefesh.ai/signup (free, 1,000 calls/month, no credit card).

tools.name: request_api_key
tools.description: Request a free API key by email. Sends verification email. Poll with check_api_key_status until ready.

tools.name: check_api_key_status
tools.description: Poll for API key activation after email verification. Returns 'pending' or 'ready' with the key.

tools.name: get_human_state
tools.description: Get current stress state (0-100), state label (Calm/Relaxed/Focused/Stressed/Acute Stress), confidence, suggested_action, and adaptation_effectiveness.

tools.name: ingest
tools.description: Send biometric signals from any sensor — heart rate, HRV, voice tone, facial expression, text sentiment, and 30+ more fields. Returns unified state.

tools.name: get_trigger_memory
tools.description: Retrieve psychological trigger profile for a subject. Shows which conversation topics cause stress (active) and which have been resolved.

tools.name: get_session_history
tools.description: Get state history over time for a session. Returns trend (rising/falling/stable) and historical datapoints.

tools.name: delete_subject
tools.description: GDPR-compliant cascading deletion of all data for a subject.

resources.description: Live session state as a subscribable resource.
